audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Can I connect my own laptop or tablet to your AV setup?

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Is a technician included for a product launch?

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Do you provide staging or a riser for the product reveal?

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Do you provide live streaming or video recording for a product launch?

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: How many microphones are included for a product launch?

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a product launch?

audio-visual-rental-company.question: What events does Malaga Event Gear cover?

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: What AV equipment do I need for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: A gooseneck microphone for the boardroom, a projector and screen, and PA sound sized to a small group. The Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts. See A Board Meeting Is Not a Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How is a corporate meeting different from a conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: A conference needs a large room and often breakout sessions running in parallel. A board meeting, client meeting or investor panel is smaller and more routine: a boardroom or hotel suite, a fixed speaker position, no breakout rooms. See our audio visual rental for conferences guide for the larger case.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: Is a technician included for a corporate meeting?

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a corporate meeting?

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How many people can a corporate meeting AV setup accommodate?

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: Do you provide video conferencing equipment for hybrid meetings?

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: What are the real advantages of renting wedding AV instead of buying it?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Professional brand name gear (Shure, QSC and Martin), a live technician included on the Wedding Pack, flat transparent pricing with delivery and teardown built in, and no equipment to store or maintain after the wedding.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: What are the real downsides of Malaga Event Gear's wedding packages?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Only two fixed guest count tiers (50 or 80, no in between sizing), delivery only with no self pickup option, no walk in showroom to test gear beforehand, and fixed prices with no negotiation or off season discount.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Is it worth buying my own PA system and lighting for a single wedding?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: For most couples, no. The upfront cost of professional grade gear rarely pays off for a single event, and there is usually no realistic plan for storing or maintaining it afterward. Renting trades that cost and burden for one flat fee.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Should I rent an AV package or hire a full production company?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: A full production company offers a larger team and fully custom staging, at a higher price than a package like the Wedding Pack. For most weddings under 80 guests, that level of customization is more than the day needs, and the Wedding Pack's fixed price and included technician cover the same core job for less.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Does the Wedding Pack include a technician, or do I run the sound myself?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event. The Eco Pack, for up to 50 guests, is self run after our crew delivers, installs and tests it, a real difference worth weighing alongside the 360 euro price gap.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Can I negotiate the price or get a self pickup option to save money?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: No to both. MEG's package prices are fixed with no negotiation, price matching or off season discount, and we operate delivery only with no self pickup option under any circumstances.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: How many guests can your AV packages support?

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: What is the difference between hiring AV equipment and hiring a DJ?

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: What AV equipment do I need for a press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: A podium microphone, PA sound that reaches the room, and a screen for branding or slides. The Basic MICE Pack covers a smaller press conference; the MICE Pack covers a larger one with a technician included. See Press Conference vs. General Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Do you provide a camera riser or platform for press photographers?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: We don't supply cameras, but our staging add on on the MICE Pack can be positioned as a riser or platform for photographers and camera operators.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: How many microphones do I need for a press conference?

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Do you provide live streaming, broadcast feed or video recording?

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: What AV equipment is needed for a conference?

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How much does audio visual rental for a conference cost?

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How is a conference AV setup different from a corporate event or press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: A corporate event is usually a single room with one setup. A press conference is built around one speaker area and a podium mic. A conference is the more demanding case: a plenary session plus one or more breakout rooms running in parallel, each needing its own sound and screen. See How This Differs from a Corporate Event or Press Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: Can you run AV for a plenary session and breakout rooms on the same day?

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a conference?

audio-visual-rental.question: What is the difference between renting AV equipment and hiring a full production company?
audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the event. Our Eco Pack is a delivery, setup and teardown service for private parties, no technician required. See Rental vs. Full Production Company above.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: What items does Malaga Event Gear actually provide for a wedding?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: PA sound, ambient lighting, wireless microphones and a live technician, bundled in the Wedding Pack for 650 euros ex VAT. We do not supply furniture, tents, linens, catering or decor.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Does the Wedding Pack include chairs, tables or linens?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: No. Those come from a furniture rental company or, in many cases, are already included in the venue's own hire.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Do venues around Malaga usually include furniture in the hire?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Many fincas and villas on the Costa del Sol bundle a base level of furniture into the venue rental itself. This varies by venue, so confirm directly with yours before renting furniture separately.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Should ceremony microphones be wired or wireless?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Wired is usually safer for the officiant during vows, since it removes any risk of a dropped wireless signal at the one moment of the day that cannot be redone. Wireless suits reception speeches and toasts, where guests move between the microphone and their seats.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Is ceremony sound the same setup as reception sound?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: No. Ceremony sound is tuned for clarity at a lower volume for a seated audience. Reception sound covers speeches at similar clarity, then switches to music at dance volume, a different tuning task our live technician adjusts for throughout the event.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: How much does wedding lighting rental cost?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: MEG's wedding lighting comes bundled inside two packages rather than sold separately. The Wedding Pack includes fairy lights and warm LED strings for 650 euros ex VAT, and the Eco Pack includes RGBW spotlights for 290 euros ex VAT. Both prices cover the full package, sound and microphones included, not lighting alone.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: What's the difference between uplighting and spotlighting?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Uplighting sits on the floor and washes light upward against a wall or structure. Spotlighting aims a narrow beam at a specific point, like a table or the couple. We stock both: a wireless uplighting kit of 6 fixtures as a separate quote-on-request item, and the Eco Pack's RGBW light bars for a fixed position spotlight and color accent. Neither is bundled into the Wedding Pack, so contact us if your reception needs uplighting alongside it.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Can wedding lighting include gobo or monogram projection?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Not through MEG. Gobo and monogram projection, casting a couple's initials or a pattern onto a wall or floor, isn't part of either package. If that's specifically what you're after, it needs a separate specialty lighting vendor. Our essential items for wedding rentals guide covers the full line of what MEG does and doesn't rent.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Where should fairy lights be placed at an outdoor wedding?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Pergola beams, trees along a walkway, and directly over a reception area are the three placements that come up most at Malaga area venues. Wind and what the structure can actually hold decide the exact anchoring on the day, which our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide covers in more depth for the rest of the outdoor setup.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Does any MEG lighting change color for the dance floor?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Yes, but only on the Eco Pack, whose RGBW light bars produce color changing light suited to a dance floor. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights and warm LED strings stay a fixed warm tone and don't change color, an important distinction if a color changing dance floor look is specifically what you want.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: What AV equipment do I need for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: It depends on the moment: a wireless microphone for the emcee and speeches, sound for the room, and staging if the evening includes a live auction. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Wedding Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger fundraising gala, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: What size fundraiser does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: The Wedding Pack covers up to 80 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See Match Your Fundraiser to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Do you provide staging for a live auction?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, on the MICE Pack, modular staging and a methacrylate lectern are available as add ons for a live auction or emcee segment.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Can you display the current bid or a donor recognition slide?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, the MICE Pack includes a 60 inch LED display that can show a bid, a donor recognition slide or event branding.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Is a technician included for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, both the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site, so a dropped microphone connection during the auction gets fixed immediately.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a larger fundraiser with multiple moments to coordinate, such as speeches, an auction and entertainment, book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How long has Malaga Event Gear been providing audio visual rental?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Malaga Event Gear has been running live events across Malaga and the Costa del Sol since 1996, three decades of hands-on experience.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack for a club event up to the MICE Pack for a full tournament, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What AV equipment do I need for a sports event's announcer PA?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: An announcer PA needs active PA sound reinforcement sized to carry over crowd noise, plus a wired, wireless or gooseneck microphone for the announcer or match commentator. See AV Built for Match Day above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Can outdoor sports events use the same AV equipment as indoor venues?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Our PA sound, lighting and staging all travel to outdoor pitches, courts and tracks. The real constraint is power: tell us what mains power is available at your outdoor venue when you book, so we can size the setup correctly. See Outdoor Setups above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Do you provide microphones for match commentary or medal ceremonies?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Yes. We provide wired, wireless and gooseneck microphones for match commentary, team introductions and sponsor speeches, plus a methacrylate lectern for medal ceremonies and opening remarks.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What size screen or projector is best for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Our 60 inch LED display, on the MICE Pack, suits a larger tournament venue; our 3000 lumen projector and screen, on the Basic MICE Pack, suits a mid-size venue. Tell us your venue size when you book and we will match the right screen.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Is a smoke machine available for team walkouts or ceremony openings?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Yes, our smoke machine is available as an add on on the Eco Pack, for team walkouts and ceremony openings. See Staging for Medal Ceremonies and Team Walkouts above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed, especially for a tournament with a ceremony on a fixed schedule. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during the spring and autumn sports season.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What sports events has Malaga Event Gear worked on before?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: We delivered the full lights and sound setup for the Billie Jean King Cup 2024, including the awards ceremony. See the Case Study above.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: What is actually trending in wedding rentals right now?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: Most "wedding rental trend" content covers decor, tablescapes, and catering, none of which MEG offers. On our own AV side, the real pattern is more couples booking the technician included Wedding Pack over a self run setup, and wireless microphones becoming a default expectation for reception speeches rather than a special request.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Is a live wedding AV technician a standard trend now, or still optional?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and the full MICE Pack include a live technician on site throughout the event. The Basic MICE Pack does not include one by default, but it can be added from 240 euros per day. The Eco Pack is delivered and tested by our crew, then run without a technician for the rest of the event. See our making the most of your wedding rentals guide for how to brief the technician once you've booked.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Are couples choosing warm static lighting or color changing lighting more often for weddings?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: Both, depending on guest count and the look they want. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights give a fixed warm glow for up to 80 guests. The Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights give color changing accents for up to 50 guests. Neither is a default over the other. Our lighting ideas for wedding rentals guide has the full comparison.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Does Malaga Event Gear offer an eco friendly or sustainable rental option?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: The Eco Pack is our smallest, simplest setup, two speakers, one microphone, two light bars, self run after our crew delivers and tests it. It's a genuinely smaller footprint installation for smaller events, but it is not a certified sustainability program, and we don't market it as one.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: What equipment brands does MEG use for wedding AV rentals?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: We use premium professional brands trusted in the live event industry, including Shure, QSC, and Martin, across both the Wedding Pack and the Eco Pack, to ensure reliable, high fidelity sound and lighting performance.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: How does audio visual equipment work?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Audio visual systems combine sound and visual technology: microphones and playback devices as inputs, mixers and amplifiers to process the signal, and speakers, projectors or displays as outputs, all working together to reach your audience.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Is it cheaper to rent or buy a sound system?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Renting is generally more cost effective for a single event or occasional use, since it avoids the maintenance and storage costs of owning equipment you rarely use. Our Eco Pack covers a small private event with sound, microphone and lighting included, delivered and collected for you.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: What is the audio visual rental process step by step?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Get a quote from our packages page, confirm your booking, and our crew handles delivery, installation and testing on the day. On packages with a technician, they stay on site during your event, then our crew returns afterward to collect everything. See The Rental Process, Step by Step above.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Is setup and teardown included in the price, or is it extra?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Setup and teardown are always included in the price shown on our packages page. This is a full service delivery model: our crew installs, tests and collects the equipment, you never do it yourself.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Why is technical support important during events with AV rentals?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: A technician on site means a dropped microphone connection or a projector that will not sync gets fixed immediately, not after your event has already suffered for it. Whether a technician is included depends on your package: see Technician Support above.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: What types of events are suitable for audio visual rentals?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Audio visual rental suits weddings, corporate meetings and conferences, private parties, and product presentations, with a package sized to each: from the Eco Pack for a small private party up to the MICE Pack for a full conference.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Can I change or cancel my AV rental booking?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Contact us as soon as you know about a change or cancellation, and we will do our best to accommodate it. Reach out via our contact page to discuss your specific booking.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Does a technician stay on site to react if the weather changes during my event?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Only on the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, which include a live technician throughout the event who can reposition equipment, add moisture protection to cables, or adjust for wind as conditions change. The Eco Pack and Basic MICE Pack are self run after our crew installs and tests the system, so nobody is there to react afterward.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Is your AV equipment weatherproof?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: We do not publish a weatherproof rating for any of our equipment. Wireless microphone receivers are moisture sensitive and can drop signal, cabling and connectors are an electrical safety risk in wet conditions, and heat affects the electronics in active PA systems and LED lighting over a long outdoor run. A live technician, where one is included, is what actually manages that risk in real time.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Do you supply tents, canopies or generators for outdoor weather protection?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: No. We do not stock tents, canopies, marquees, generators, portable air conditioning or heaters. Venue provided shelter and power need to be confirmed by you directly with your venue. Tell us what is available when you book so our technician can plan the AV setup around it.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: If the forecast changes close to my event date, how much flexibility do I have?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: All bookings and changes to one need at least 24 hours' notice to guarantee scheduling and logistical availability. Checking the forecast a week out leaves real room to adjust your package or add ons. Checking it inside that 24 hour window still gets an availability check, not a guarantee. See our managing last minute wedding rental changes guide for the full mechanics.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Who handles the equipment if it rains, me or your crew?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Our crew. We operate delivery only, there is no self pickup option, so our own trained team transports, installs and retrieves every system regardless of weather, rather than a client handling the gear themselves.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: How does wind affect where you place speakers and lighting outdoors?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Wind changes where a speaker stand or lighting rig can safely stand on grass, sand or a windy terrace. Our technician reads the actual ground and wind exposure on site. Our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide covers this in more depth for wedding venues specifically.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Is it cheaper to rent or buy AV equipment?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: For most one-off or occasional events, renting is cheaper: our packages start at 290 euros, ex VAT, with delivery, setup and teardown included, versus a large upfront purchase plus storage and maintenance between uses.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: What is included in an AV rental price?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Delivery, professional setup, testing and teardown, on every package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack also include a technician on site. See exact inclusions per package on our packages page.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Do I need to store or maintain the equipment myself?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: No. Our crew delivers the equipment before your event and collects it afterward, so you never store, transport or maintain it between events.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Is a technician included, or do I run the equipment myself?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site. On other packages, a technician is available as an add on, or the equipment is delivered ready to run yourself.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How do I know which package fits my event?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the event type and guest count: an Eco Pack for a small private party, a Wedding Pack for a wedding, a Product Presentation or Basic MICE Pack for a corporate meeting, or a MICE Pack for a larger conference or gala. See Flexibility for Different Events above.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How much does audio visual rental cost in Malaga?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Our packages range from 290 euros for the Eco Pack to 650 euros for the Wedding Pack, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. See live pricing for every package on our packages page.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How far in advance should I book audio visual rental?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

projector-rental.question: Can I rent just a projection screen, without a projector?
projector-rental.answer: No. We do not sell a projection screen on its own. Every screen we deploy is bundled with a projector sized to it, whether that is the Eco Pack's 50 euro add on or the fixed screen and projector inclusion on the Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack. See Why the Screen Is Always Bundled With the Projector above.

projector-rental.question: Is a screen included with the projector, or sold separately?
projector-rental.answer: Included, always. The Eco Pack bundles "projector & projection screen" as one 50 euro add on line. The Basic MICE Pack includes a 2x2m screen with its 3000 lumen projector. The Product Presentation Pack includes a front projection screen with a stable stand alongside its 5000 lumen laser projector. We do not sell either piece on its own.

projector-rental.question: What's the largest screen size available?
projector-rental.answer: 2x2 meters, on the Basic MICE Pack. We do not publish a larger a la carte screen size.

projector-rental.question: What brightness or lumens do I need for a daylit or brightly lit room?
projector-rental.answer: For a standard boardroom or a room you can dim, the 3000 lumen projector on the Basic MICE Pack is the right tier. For a room that stays lit, such as a dealership showroom during a launch or a press event with photographers, the 5000 lumen Full HD laser projector on the Product Presentation Pack is built for that. See Choosing a Lumens Tier for Your Room above.

projector-rental.question: Do you offer 4K or laser projectors?
projector-rental.answer: Laser, yes: the Product Presentation Pack uses a 5000 lumen Full HD laser projector. We do not publish 4K resolution on either projector tier we offer.

projector-rental.question: Can you project onto a building facade or do outdoor projection mapping?
projector-rental.answer: No. Facade projection and outdoor projection mapping fall outside our current catalog. Our projector and screen setups are built for indoor presentations, conferences and product showcases, not building scale outdoor projection.

projector-rental.question: Is setup and installation included?
projector-rental.answer: Yes, on every package. Our crew delivers, installs and tests the projector and screen before your event starts, then returns afterward to collect everything, the same delivery, install, test and collect model we use across our full catalog.

projector-rental.question: How much does a projector rental cost?
projector-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack is 290 euros base, plus a 50 euro add on for the projector and screen. The Basic MICE Pack, which bundles the projector and screen as standard, is 295 euros. The Product Presentation Pack, with its 5000 lumen laser projector, is 310 euros. All prices are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. See Projector and Screen Pricing by Package above.

projector-rental.question: How far in advance should I book a projector rental?
projector-rental.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during wedding season, from April through October, and corporate bookings tied to a fixed conference or launch date should lock in early. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

projector-rental.question: Can I connect my own laptop or tablet to the projector?
projector-rental.answer: Yes. On the Product Presentation Pack, we provide HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces so your own laptop, tablet or media player connects to our screen and sound system without a last minute cable scramble.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: What should an itemized wedding AV rental quote include?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: Guest capacity, what the sound system and lighting actually are, how many microphones and what kind, whether a technician is included, whether transport, setup and teardown are bundled in, the net price, and VAT shown separately. See the checklist above for how MEG's own packages answer each one.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Does the price include delivery and setup, or are those separate line items?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: On both of MEG's wedding sized packages, transport, setup and teardown are included in the listed price rather than billed separately. Confirm this on any other quote you're comparing, since it is often billed apart elsewhere.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Does the quoted price include VAT?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: No. MEG's listed prices are ex 21 percent VAT, and the final quote shows the net price and the VAT separately. A quote that does not state this either way is worth asking about directly.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Is a technician included, or is that a separate line item?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: It depends on the package, which is exactly why it belongs on the checklist. MEG's Wedding Pack includes a live technician throughout the event. The Eco Pack does not, and is self run after our crew delivers, installs and tests it.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Why do two quotes for what looks like the same package land at different prices?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: Almost always one of four things: a different guest capacity rating, whether a technician is included, whether VAT is already in the number, or whether setup and teardown are bundled in or billed separately. See the section above for how to tell which one is driving the gap.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: What AV equipment do I need for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: It depends on the moment: ambient lighting and sound for the reception, a wireless microphone for speeches and toasts, and staging for an awards presentation. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Wedding Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger awards gala, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: What size gala does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: The Wedding Pack covers up to 80 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See Match Your Gala to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: Do you provide staging for an awards presentation?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Yes, on the MICE Pack, modular staging and a methacrylate lectern are available as add ons for an awards presentation or formal remarks.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: Is a technician included for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Yes, both the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site, so a dropped microphone connection or a lighting cue that misses gets fixed immediately.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a larger gala with multiple moments to coordinate, such as speeches, an awards segment and entertainment, book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How long has Malaga Event Gear been providing audio visual rental?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Backed by experience going back to 1996, three decades of live events across Malaga and the Costa del Sol.

event-technology-service.question: What Is "Event Technology" and What Does MEG Actually Provide?
event-technology-service.answer: At Malaga Event Gear, event technology means the physical layer of an event: RGBW and specialty stage lighting, modular stage platforms, and an on site technician. It does not mean streaming, video mapping or interactive software, which some local competitors market under the same name. See Why "Event Technology" Means Something Different Here above.

event-technology-service.question: Is Event Technology the Same as Audiovisual Equipment Rental?
event-technology-service.answer: They overlap but are not identical. Our audio visual rental pillar covers the full package range, from the Eco Pack up to the MICE Pack, and our audiovisual equipment rental service pillar indexes the specialized equipment layer inside that catalog. This page is narrower still: it covers only the pieces of that catalog that fit an "event technology" framing, lighting, staging and on site support, and says plainly what falls outside it.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Event Lighting Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: Yes. RGBW LED spotlights on the Eco Pack, plus a compact multi head LED light bar, a Fresnel zoom wash light and a wireless uplighting kit for larger corporate stages, quoted on request. See Event Lighting above.

event-technology-service.question: What Is Stage Design and Setup, and Do You Offer It?
event-technology-service.answer: We offer modular stage platforms on the MICE Pack at 35 euros per square meter, sized to your room. We do not offer scenic theatrical stage design, truss rigs, or pipe and drape. See Stage Design and Setup above.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide On Site Technical Support?
event-technology-service.answer: Yes, on several packages. Our AV technician hire guide covers exactly which packages include a technician and how many hours each one covers, rather than repeating that detail here.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Offer Live Streaming or Event Technology for Hybrid or Virtual Events?
event-technology-service.answer: No. Our audio visual rental for virtual events guide states it directly: we do not supply cameras, streaming encoders, or a recording service. You bring your own laptop, conferencing software and internet connection, and we supply the room's sound and screen.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Video Mapping or LED and Video Walls?
event-technology-service.answer: No. Our large format display is a single 60 inch flat panel, not a modular tiled video wall, and our projector setups do not include facade projection or outdoor mapping. See What We Don't Offer above.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Offer Interactive Touchscreens, Kiosks or Audience Response Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: Touchscreens and kiosks, no: our audio visual rental for religious events guide rules those out on the same grounds it rules out a video wall. Audience response or voting systems, yes as an arranged service: we don't stock the hardware ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner for corporate and congress-grade events.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Event Apps, RFID Tracking or Ticketing Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: No. This is a scope boundary, not a gap we are hiding. It also sits outside what the local event technology competitors we looked at for this page actually sell, since they are physical AV and production companies rather than registration or ticketing platforms.

event-technology-service.question: How Far in Advance Should I Book Event Technology for My Event?
event-technology-service.answer: As early as your date is confirmed. Demand peaks during wedding season, from April through October, when technicians and specialty stage lighting fixtures are the first things to fill up. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: What should I ask before booking wedding AV rentals?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Ask what's included in the price, whether a technician is on site, how many guests the sound system covers, and whether the quoted price includes VAT. See the sections above for how Malaga Event Gear answers each one.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Does Malaga Event Gear provide a written breakdown of what's included?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Yes. The packages page itemizes exactly what's in the Wedding Pack: PA sound, lighting, microphones, transport, setup and the technician, at 650 euros ex VAT.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Is a technician always included in wedding AV packages?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Not necessarily, and it's worth asking directly. In our own catalog, only the Wedding Pack and the MICE Pack include a live technician on site throughout the event.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: What if a provider can't confirm availability for my date?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Ask when they can confirm it, and keep that timeline in mind since availability, not price, is what limits a date. See our booking timeline guide.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Does the price change based on guest count?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: The Wedding Pack is a flat 650 euros ex VAT for up to 80 guests. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options rather than assuming the same package scales automatically.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our Eco Pack covers PA sound, a microphone and lighting, with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and the price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: Is a technician included for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: No, not on the Eco Pack: it is a self run setup, delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then operated by the DJ or band themselves. A technician is included on our Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, though those are sized for a wedding or corporate event.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: What is the difference between a setup for a DJ and a live band?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: The base equipment is the same: PA sound, a microphone and lighting. A DJ typically brings their own mixer and controller and plugs into our sound system. A live band or duo uses the microphone for vocals and plugs their own instruments in directly.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How many microphones are included?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: The Eco Pack includes 1 wired dynamic microphone. If your performance needs more than one, let us know when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: Can the sound system be used outdoors, at a villa or beach venue?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Yes. Our PA sound and lighting are set up regularly at villas, terraces and beach venues across the Costa del Sol. Confirm the venue's mains power when you book so we can size the setup correctly.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros, and we recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: What is the difference between audio visual hire near me and audio video rental near me?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: They cover different parts of our catalog. Audio visual hire near me covers our general sound and lighting packages for weddings and parties. This page covers the screen and projector side of our catalog, for presentations, conferences and product launches.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: What size screen or projector do I need?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: For a smaller meeting room up to 40 guests, the Basic MICE Pack's 2x2m screen and 3000-lumen projector work well. For a larger conference room up to 120 guests, the MICE Pack's 60 inch LED display avoids a long projector throw distance. See Which Screen or Projector Fits Your Room above.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: Can I connect my own laptop to the projector or screen?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: Is a technician included?

Ceiling height and room shape also change how sound reflects, which is why our technician places speakers for the specific room rather than one fixed layout.

indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.question: Does a room's acoustics affect microphone feedback?
