audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A laser projector and screen for slides, PA sound, and a microphone for the presenter. The Product Presentation Pack and Basic MICE Pack cover these needs at different scales. See Match Your Seminar to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a seminar?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the Product Presentation Pack, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: What is the difference between AV for a small seminar and a larger one?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A single presenter with a wireless mic fits the Product Presentation Pack. A lectern-style seminar or workshop up to 40 guests fits the Basic MICE Pack, which uses a gooseneck podium microphone instead.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: What microphone is best for a seminar speaker?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A wireless handheld microphone, included on the Product Presentation Pack, suits a presenter who moves around. A gooseneck microphone, included on the Basic MICE Pack, suits a lectern or podium format.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: Do I need a technician for a seminar AV setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Not on the Product Presentation Pack: the equipment is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. On the Basic MICE Pack, a technician is available as an add on.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: Can I connect my own laptop to the projector?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How many people can attend a seminar with a standard AV setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: The Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests. For a larger seminar, see our audio visual rental for conferences guide.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a seminar?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: What AV equipment do I need for a training session?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: It depends on your group size and format. A small, laptop-driven workshop needs a sound system, a wireless microphone and a projector, which the Product Presentation Pack covers. A larger session benefits from a bigger screen and a technician, which the Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack cover. See Match Your Training Session to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Is my training session too small for professional AV support?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: No. Our Product Presentation Pack is built for a small, laptop-driven session, with sound, a wireless microphone and a projector delivered, installed and tested by our crew.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Do you provide on-site technical support during the session, or is it drop-off equipment only?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: It depends on the package. The Product Presentation Pack is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. The Basic MICE Pack offers a technician as an add on, and the MICE Pack includes one on site for up to six hours.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Can the AV setup handle a trainer moving between breakout groups?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Yes. Our wireless handheld microphones, included on the Product Presentation Pack and MICE Pack, let a trainer move freely between groups and exercise stations without losing sound clarity. See Trainer Mobility above.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Can I connect my own laptop for my training slides?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your own laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: What areas do you cover, and how far in advance should I book?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros. Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: What's included in an all in one wedding rental package from Malaga Event Gear?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a high end PA sound system for up to 80 guests, warm ambient lighting, wireless microphones for vows and speeches, transport, professional setup, a live technician on site throughout the event, and post event teardown, all for 650 euros ex VAT.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Does the all in one package include venue, catering or furniture?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: No. The Wedding Pack covers audio visual equipment only: sound, lighting, microphones and a technician. Venue, catering, furniture, decor and photography are separate trades and are not part of this package.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Is booking one all in one package cheaper than hiring separate AV vendors?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: It removes the coordination cost of managing separate suppliers, separate delivery windows and separate contacts on the day, even where the equipment itself is comparable. One quote and one team on site is the main practical benefit.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Is a technician included in the package?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: Yes. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event, one of only two packages in our catalog that does, alongside the MICE Pack.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: How many guests does the package support?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: Up to 80 guests, sized for a villa, finca or wedding hotel. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Is the Difference Between This Page and Your General Audio Visual Rental Page?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: They describe the same core service. Our audio visual rental page covers the full package range, from the Eco Pack up to the MICE Pack. This page indexes the specialized and niche equipment layer inside that same catalog, the laser projector tier, RGBW spotlights, specialty stage lighting and uplighting, wireless and gooseneck microphones, the 60 inch LED display and special effects, plus an honest list of what falls outside our catalog. See Why This Page Exists above.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent a Mixing Console or Audio Mixer on Its Own?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. Our digital mixing consoles are technician operated equipment built into the Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack, not a standalone rental item. See our sound system rental guide for the full detail.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Offer Headset or Lavalier Microphones?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Yes. We stock wireless lavalier and headset microphones as a separate item from our package inclusions, for a presenter or performer who needs a hands free mic. See Wireless and Gooseneck Microphone Systems above.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Provide Simultaneous Interpretation or Translation Equipment?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Not from our own equipment catalog, but yes as an arranged service: we don't stock interpretation hardware ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner to cover it rather than turn the request away. Contact us with your language pairs and guest count.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Is Uplighting and Do You Rent It?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Uplighting sits on the floor and washes light upward against a wall or structure. Yes, we rent it: a wireless, battery powered uplighting kit of 6 fixtures, a separate item from the Eco Pack's RGBW light bars, which spotlight and color a room from a fixed position rather than washing a wall from the floor. Contact us with your venue and guest count for a quote. See our lighting ideas for wedding rentals guide for the full picture.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent a Video Wall or LED Wall?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. Our large format display is a single 60 inch flat panel screen on a designer stand, not a modular tiled video wall built from stacked LED cabinets. See our TV screen rental guide for what we publish instead.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Can I Rent a Projection Screen Without a Projector, or Vice Versa?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. We do not sell a projection screen on its own, and we do not rent a projector without one. Every screen we deploy is bundled with a projector sized to it, whether that's the Eco Pack's 50 euro add on or the fixed screen and projector inclusion on the Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack. See our projector rental guide for the full breakdown.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Provide Interactive Voting or Audience Response Systems?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Not from our own equipment catalog, but yes as an arranged service: clicker devices, live polling hardware and interactive voting systems aren't something we stock ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner to cover them for a congress or corporate event. Contact us with your requirements.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Laser or Special Lighting Effects Do You Offer?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Our brightest projector is a 5000 lumen Full HD laser unit on the Product Presentation Pack. On the effects side, our catalog lists low lying fog machines for a cloud effect, hazers to enhance light beams, and professional confetti cannons, with the fog machine published as a 20 euro Eco Pack add on. We do not offer laser light shows, gobo or monogram projection, or hologram displays. See Special Effects above.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent Staging, Truss or Pipe and Drape?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Staging, yes, as a priced add on: modular stage platforms at 35 euros per square meter on the MICE Pack. Truss, no, we don't stock it as a separate rental item. Pipe and drape or event backdrops, also no: we are not a decor provider, and that's stated directly on our unique wedding ceremony rentals guide. See Modular Staging for Corporate Events above.

technical-support-for-events.question: What happens during my event? A quick coverage checklist
technical-support-for-events.answer: Calibration and testing before your guests arrive, live gain and signal monitoring while your event runs, on the spot troubleshooting if a microphone or projector fails, and teardown once your event ends. See What Actually Happens During Your Event above for the full phase by phase breakdown.

technical-support-for-events.question: Is technical support for events the same as AV technician hire?
technical-support-for-events.answer: They cover the same crew from two different angles. Our AV technician hire guide covers hiring the person: which package includes one, which charges extra, and how many hours. This page covers what that person actually does on site once your event starts.

technical-support-for-events.question: What happens if a microphone drops or a projector loses sync mid presentation?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Our technician fixes it in the moment, using the specific equipment we carry: a channel switch or battery change for an Audix wireless microphone, or a resync against the correct Vivitek or Christie projector and screen pairing. See Real Equipment, Real Troubleshooting above.

technical-support-for-events.question: Do you provide technical support for multi day events?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Yes. On a two day corporate project for Bmotion in Benahavis, our technicians monitored sound and video continuously from a control panel across both days rather than recalibrating from zero each morning. See Coverage Across a Multi Day Event above.

technical-support-for-events.question: How many crew members are on site, and how fast do they respond?
technical-support-for-events.answer: A dedicated technician is on site for the duration your package covers, watching the sound and visual signal chain directly rather than being called in after a fault is noticed, so a dropped connection or lighting cue gets caught and corrected immediately.

technical-support-for-events.question: Is the technician actively monitoring the event, or just on standby?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Actively monitoring. On the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, the technician watches levels, video inputs and lighting cues continuously throughout the event, they are not a standby presence called in only if something visibly breaks.

technical-support-for-events.question: Is onsite tech support included in my package, or a separate booking?
technical-support-for-events.answer: It depends on the package, not a blanket rule: included on the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, available as a paid add on on the Basic MICE Pack, and not offered on the Eco Pack. See How Much On Site Coverage Do You Actually Get above for the full breakdown.

technical-support-for-events.question: What is the difference between delivery only and full event coverage?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Delivery only, on the Eco Pack, means our crew delivers, sets up and tests the equipment, then leaves it to the DJ or host to run. Full event coverage means a technician stays on site actively monitoring and troubleshooting for the length of your event. See our how audio visual rental works guide for the full delivery process either way.

technical-support-for-events.question: Do you provide technical support for outdoor venues?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Yes, across Malaga and the Costa del Sol. Calibration for an outdoor venue includes the same signal testing as an indoor one, with extra attention to weather exposure and cabling. See our audio visual rental for outdoor events guide for the specific considerations.

technical-support-for-events.question: Can your technician switch between multiple presentation sources during my event?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Yes, on packages with a large screen and more than one presentation source, our technician manages the switch between them (a laptop, a second laptop, a DVD player) using a Kramer VP-731 9 input video scaler, cutting cleanly between sources. This is a presentation switching tool only, not a camera, recording or streaming system. See Switching Between Multiple Presentation Sources above.

timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.question: How far in advance should I book wedding rentals in Malaga?
timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.answer: There is no fixed rule. What matters is availability for your specific date, which is tighter during peak season (spring through early autumn). Book once your venue and date are confirmed to secure the Wedding Pack and its technician.

timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.question: Does booking earlier get me a better price?
timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.answer: No. The Wedding Pack is a flat 650 euros, ex VAT, regardless of how far ahead you book. Booking early affects availability, not price.

timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.question: Is the technician available on any date I choose?
timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.answer: Availability depends on the date, same as the equipment itself. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event. Confirm availability for your specific date as early as you can.

timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.question: What if I need to change my wedding date after booking?
timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.answer: Contact us as soon as a date changes. We will confirm whether the new date is available for the Wedding Pack and technician.

timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.question: What's included in the Wedding Pack?
timeline-for-booking-wedding-rentals.answer: PA sound for up to 80 guests, fairy light ambient lighting, wireless microphones, transport, setup and a live technician. See our audio visual rental for weddings guide for the full breakdown.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: What equipment do I need for a remote presentation?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: Room sound so people can hear the call, a screen so they can see it, and a way to connect your laptop to both. Our Product Presentation Pack covers all three with HDMI and USB-C adapters included. See A Remote Presenter, Not a Full Virtual Event above.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: What is the difference between a remote presentation and a virtual event?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: A remote presentation is usually one remote speaker or participant joining an otherwise in-person room. A virtual event covers a full session or conference run mostly or entirely online. Either way, we supply the same thing: the room's sound, screen and laptop connectivity. See our audio visual rental for virtual events guide for the larger case.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: Can a remote presenter join an in-person meeting or event?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: Yes. Connect your own laptop or video call to our screen and sound system through the adapters included on the Product Presentation Pack, and the room can see and hear the remote presenter without any extra equipment.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: Do you provide cameras or webcams for remote presentations?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: No. We provide the room's sound and screen, not cameras, webcams or streaming equipment. You run the call from your own laptop and software.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: Can I use my own laptop with your setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: Yes, the Product Presentation Pack comes with HDMI and USB-C adapters, plus audio interfaces, so you can plug in a laptop, tablet or media player directly.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: What size package do I need for a small remote-participant meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: For a boardroom-scale meeting, the Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests with a gooseneck microphone and a projector and screen. For a larger conference room, the MICE Pack covers up to 120 guests with a 60 inch LED display and a technician included.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: Do you provide internet or wifi for the call?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: No. Internet and wifi are not included in any of our packages, so confirm connectivity with your venue ahead of the event.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: Is a technician included for a remote presentation setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: Not on every package. The MICE Pack includes a technician on site for up to six hours; on the Basic MICE Pack a technician is available as an add on. Ask when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a remote presentation?
audio-visual-rental-for-remote-presentat.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger conference room, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

av-technician-hire.question: Can I hire just an AV technician, without renting your equipment?
av-technician-hire.answer: No. We do not sell a technician as a standalone service, only as part of one of our own equipment packages. See Can You Hire Just a Technician, Without the Equipment? above.

av-technician-hire.question: Which packages include an AV technician?
av-technician-hire.answer: The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include one as standard, the Basic MICE Pack offers one as a paid add on at 240 euros per day, and the Eco Pack does not offer one at all. See Technician by Package above for the full breakdown.

av-technician-hire.question: What does an AV technician actually do during my event?
av-technician-hire.answer: They run gain staging and signal testing before your event starts, adjust microphone levels live as different speakers take the mic, manage the handoff between speakers so there is no dead air, and fix a dropped connection or a projector that loses sync in the moment. See What an AV Technician Actually Does On Site above.

av-technician-hire.question: How much does it cost to add a technician to the Basic MICE Pack?
av-technician-hire.answer: 240 euros per day, ex VAT, on top of the 295 euro Basic MICE Pack price. The technician is available for the full event day once added.

av-technician-hire.question: Is the Wedding Pack technician on site for the whole event, or a set number of hours?
av-technician-hire.answer: The whole event, with no hour cap. This is the only package where technician coverage is not limited to a fixed number of hours, which matters for a wedding day that runs from ceremony through dancing.

av-technician-hire.question: What happens if my event runs longer than the MICE Pack's 6 hour technician cap?
av-technician-hire.answer: Each additional hour is billed at 40 euros. If your event is likely to run past 6 hours, mention your expected run time when you book so we can confirm the technician's availability and cost for the extra hours in advance.

av-technician-hire.question: Do I need a technician for a small party or DJ set?
av-technician-hire.answer: Usually not. The Eco Pack is a self run PA system with no technician on site, built for a DJ or host who controls their own levels. See our audio visual rental for music performances guide.

av-technician-hire.question: How far in advance should I book if I need a technician?
av-technician-hire.answer: As early as you can once your event date is confirmed. Demand for technician covered packages, especially the Wedding Pack, peaks during wedding season from April through October, when technicians book up first.

av-technician-hire.question: What experience does your AV technician have?
av-technician-hire.answer: Our technicians are our own crew, not a subcontracted team, and Malaga Event Gear has operated in the audiovisual rental sector since 1996. Every technician we send is dispatched with our own equipment, which is what they are trained and calibrated on.

av-technician-hire.question: Do you provide an AV technician for events outside Malaga city, like Marbella or Fuengirola?
av-technician-hire.answer: Yes. Our technician covered packages serve Malaga city and extend across the Costa del Sol, including Marbella and Fuengirola. Contact us with your venue so we can confirm coverage for your specific location.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: What equipment do I need for a virtual event?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: You need in-room sound so people can hear the call, a screen or display so they can see it, and a way to connect your laptop to both. Our Product Presentation Pack covers all three with HDMI and USB-C adapters included.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a virtual event?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Product Presentation Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger conference room, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: What is the difference between a virtual event and a hybrid event?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: A fully virtual event has no in-person audience at all. A hybrid event has both an in-person room and remote participants on a call. Either way, we supply the same thing: the room's sound, screen and laptop connectivity. See What We Provide vs. What You Bring above.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: Can I connect my own laptop to your sound and screen setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: Do you provide cameras or streaming equipment?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: No. We provide the room's sound and screen, not cameras, streaming encoders or a recording service. You run the call from your own laptop and software.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: Do you provide internet or wifi for the event?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: No, internet and wifi are not part of our packages. Confirm connectivity with your venue before the event.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: Do I need an on-site AV technician?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: Not on every package. The MICE Pack includes a technician on site for up to six hours; on other packages a technician is available as an add on. Ask when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.question: How many people can your equipment support?
audio-visual-rental-for-virtual-events.answer: It scales with the package: the Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See the full comparison on our packages page.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: How do I know if an audio visual rental company is legitimate?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: Check for real, verifiable reviews, a real trading history, and transparent pricing. We hold a 5.0 average across 8 Google reviews and have operated since 1996.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: Is a technician included when I book an AV rental company?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include one standard. The Basic MICE Pack offers one as a paid add on. The Eco Pack and Product Presentation Pack do not include one.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: How much does audio visual rental cost in Malaga?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: Our packages range from 290 to 650 euros, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. Every price includes delivery, setup and teardown. See exact pricing on our packages page.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: Do I need to collect or return the equipment myself?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: No. Every package is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then collected again after your event.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: What areas do audio visual rental companies in Malaga typically cover?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: Our own service area covers Malaga and 23 towns across the Costa del Sol, extending to Sevilla and Granada for larger bookings. Confirm the real coverage area with any company before you book.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: What equipment do audio visual rental companies typically provide?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: Sound systems, lighting, microphones, projectors and screens. We do not provide cameras, live streaming equipment or video conferencing hardware, and our largest display is a single 60 inch LED screen, not a video wall.

audio-visual-rental-companies.question: How far in advance should I book an audio visual rental company?
audio-visual-rental-companies.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

tv-screen-rental.question: What screen sizes are available?
tv-screen-rental.answer: One real size: a 60 inch high definition LED display screen, included on the MICE Pack. We do not publish a smaller a la carte TV screen size. If your event needs a larger projected image instead, see the 2x2m bundled screen on our projector rental guide.

tv-screen-rental.question: Is a stand included with the screen?
tv-screen-rental.answer: Yes. The MICE Pack includes a designer stand with the 60 inch display, so it arrives ready to position rather than needing a separate mount or table.

tv-screen-rental.question: Can I rent multiple TV screens for one event?
tv-screen-rental.answer: Not as a standard line item. The published MICE Pack includes one 60 inch screen. That said, we have deployed multiple TV monitors on rolling stands for a larger corporate project, our two day setup with Bmotion in Marbella. Contact us with your room layout and guest count so we can scope the right number of screens for your event.

tv-screen-rental.question: Is a technician needed to operate the screen?
tv-screen-rental.answer: A dedicated live AV technician is included with the MICE Pack, for up to 6 continuous hours, the same technician hours inclusion that applies to the MICE Pack's sound and microphones.

tv-screen-rental.question: Do you rent LED video walls or modular LED panels?
tv-screen-rental.answer: No. Our large format display is a single 60 inch flat panel screen, not a modular tiled video wall built from stacked LED cabinets. LED walls and video walls, including outdoor stage scale configurations, fall outside our current catalog. See What We Don't Offer above.

tv-screen-rental.question: Is "TV screen," "display monitor" and "plasma screen" the same product?
tv-screen-rental.answer: Yes. All three terms describe the same flat panel display at Malaga Event Gear: the MICE Pack's premium 60 inch high definition LED display screen. "Plasma screen" is a legacy term still used colloquially in the local market. Actual plasma display technology is not what gets installed today. See Is a TV Screen the Same as a Display Monitor or Plasma Screen? above.

tv-screen-rental.question: What resolution is the screen? Is it 4K?
tv-screen-rental.answer: We publish "high definition" for the MICE Pack's screen. We do not publish a 4K or other specific resolution figure for it, so the honest answer is high definition, not 4K.

tv-screen-rental.question: Can the screen be used for hybrid meetings or video conferencing?
tv-screen-rental.answer: Yes. The MICE Pack is purpose built for corporate and meeting use: the screen carries the video call or presentation while the included gooseneck and wireless handheld microphones carry the room's voice to the remote side.

tv-screen-rental.question: Is the screen for indoor venues only, or can it go outdoors?
tv-screen-rental.answer: We do not publish an outdoor rating for this screen. The honest guidance is indoor venues, such as conference rooms, hotel ballrooms and exhibition halls. Contact us with your venue details if you are considering an outdoor placement, so we can confirm what is possible rather than guess.

tv-screen-rental.question: How much does a TV screen rental cost?
tv-screen-rental.answer: 490 euros ex VAT, for the MICE Pack, which covers the 60 inch screen and stand for up to 120 guests, plus the sound system, microphones and a technician for up to 6 hours. All prices are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. See TV Screen Rental Pricing and What's Included above.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: What AV equipment do I need for a religious event?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: A microphone for the officiant, PA sound sized to the room, and a screen for readings or hymn lyrics if the venue wants one. The Basic MICE Pack and Wedding Pack cover these needs at different guest counts. See Match Your Religious Event to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a religious event?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the Wedding Pack for a church ceremony, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: Do you provide a sound system for a church service?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: Yes, the Basic MICE Pack includes a gooseneck microphone for the lectern and PA sound reinforcement for up to 40 guests.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: What is included for a wedding ceremony in a church?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a wireless handheld microphone for vows and readings, PA sound, and a technician on site to manage sound during the ceremony, for up to 80 guests.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: Is a technician included for a religious event?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: It depends on the package. The Basic MICE Pack offers a technician as an add on; the Wedding Pack includes one on site.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: Do you provide live streaming for religious services?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: No, we do not provide cameras, streaming or broadcast equipment. Our setup covers the room's sound, microphone and screen.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: Do you provide interactive screens or multilingual interpretation technology?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: Interactive touch screens, no: our screen and projector are for displaying readings or hymn lyrics, not an interactive display. Multilingual interpretation, yes as an arranged service: we don't stock the hardware ourselves, but we can bring in a subcontracted partner on request.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: How many microphones are included?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: The Basic MICE Pack includes 1 gooseneck microphone. The Wedding Pack includes 1 wireless handheld microphone. If your event needs more than one, let us know when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a religious event?
audio-visual-rental-for-religious-events.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a ceremony with a fixed date, book as early as you can once your venue is confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

wedding-rentals.question: What's included in wedding rentals from Malaga Event Gear?
wedding-rentals.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a high-end PA sound system for up to 80 guests, warm ambient lighting (fairy lights and LED strings), wireless microphones for vows and speeches, transport, professional setup, a live technician on site throughout the event, and post-event teardown.

wedding-rentals.question: How much do wedding rentals cost in Malaga?
wedding-rentals.answer: The Wedding Pack costs 650 euros, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. The price includes delivery, setup and teardown. See exact pricing on our packages page.

wedding-rentals.question: Is a technician included with wedding rentals?
wedding-rentals.answer: Yes. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event, one of only two packages in our catalog that does, alongside the MICE Pack.

wedding-rentals.question: How many guests can the Wedding Pack support?
wedding-rentals.answer: Up to 80 guests, sized for a villa, finca or wedding hotel. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options.

wedding-rentals.question: Do wedding rentals include furniture, decor or photography?
wedding-rentals.answer: No. The Wedding Pack covers sound, lighting, microphones and a technician. It does not include furniture, decor, dancefloor accessories, or photography and videography.

wedding-rentals.question: How far in advance should I book wedding rentals?
wedding-rentals.answer: There is no fixed booking window, only availability. Wedding dates fill up quickly, particularly in peak season, so reach out once your date and venue are confirmed.

wedding-rentals-online.question: Can I book and pay for the Wedding Pack entirely online, with no phone call?
wedding-rentals-online.answer: Not yet. You can see the price and submit a full quote request online, but a team member confirms the booking by phone, WhatsApp or email afterward. There is no online payment or automated checkout at this time.

wedding-rentals-online.question: Is Wedding Pack pricing published online, or do I have to ask?
wedding-rentals-online.answer: It is published. The Wedding Pack is 650 euros ex VAT, listed on the packages page with VAT noted separately, before you contact anyone.

wedding-rentals-online.question: Do I need to visit a showroom to get a quote or confirm a booking?
wedding-rentals-online.answer: No. Malaga Event Gear has no showroom. Requesting a quote and confirming a booking both happen without an in person visit, aside from the final human confirmation step by phone, WhatsApp or email.

wedding-rentals-online.question: How long does it take to hear back after submitting the online quote form?
wedding-rentals-online.answer: Usually the same or next business day. Bookings need at least 24 hours' notice regardless, so submit your request as early as you can once your date and venue are set.

unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.question: Should a wedding officiant use a lapel or handheld microphone?
unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.answer: It depends on how much the officiant moves and whether the couple reads their own vows. Lapel mics stay hands free but cannot be angled toward a quieter speaker. Handheld mics can be angled but take up a hand during the ceremony. The Wedding Pack includes a wireless handheld microphone as standard, and we stock a wireless lapel microphone as a separate add on, so tell us your preference when you book.

unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.question: Do you need a microphone for an outdoor wedding ceremony?
unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.answer: Almost always, yes. Open air has no walls to reflect sound, so a voice that fills a small room thins out fast over grass or sand. At beach and finca venues especially, amplification is what keeps the vows audible past the first few rows.

unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.question: Does wind or nearby waves affect ceremony sound?
unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.answer: Yes, directly. Wind and waves compete with the officiant's voice for the same air, and a PA that is not positioned correctly for the specific spot and wind direction loses the vows to that background noise rather than a lack of volume. Our live technician places and levels the system for the conditions on the day.

unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.question: Can Malaga Event Gear play processional and recessional music?
unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.answer: Yes, through the same PA used for the officiant's microphone, whether the cue is a recorded playlist or a live musician we amplify. We supply the hardware and timing, not the musician or the performance.

unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.question: Does the Wedding Pack include a ceremony arch, altar or backdrop?
unique-wedding-ceremony-rentals.answer: No. MEG does not rent ceremony decor, structures or furniture of any kind. The Wedding Pack is sound, microphones and ambient lighting only. See our essential items for wedding rentals guide for the full list of what a wedding needs and where MEG fits inside it.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: What happens to AV equipment if it rains during an outdoor event?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: We do not rent tents or canopies, so if rain is a real risk, arrange a covered backup area with your venue in advance. Our technicians assess conditions on site and place equipment around whatever shelter is available.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: Do you provide a generator for venues without power access?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: No, generators are not part of our catalog. Confirm your venue's power access with us when you book, and we will size the sound and lighting setup to match what is actually available.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: How does an outdoor sound system differ from an indoor one?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: With no walls to reflect sound, open air disperses audio further than an indoor room does. Our PA systems are set up to project across the outdoor space rather than fill a closed room.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: Is a technician included for an outdoor event?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then self-run, no technician included. The Wedding Pack includes a technician on site.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: What outdoor venues do you set up at?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: We set up at villas, private gardens, hotel terraces, beach clubs and rooftops across Malaga and the wider Costa del Sol, extending to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: Can lighting and sound equipment run on grass, sand or uneven ground?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: Yes, our crew manages cable runs and stand placement for the actual ground surface at your venue when we install the equipment.

audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for an outdoor event?
audio-visual-rental-for-outdoor-events.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a larger outdoor event with weather to plan around, book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a small business event?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Eco Pack and Product Presentation Pack for a small event up to the MICE Pack for a full conference, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: Do I need an AV technician, or can I run the equipment myself?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: Not always. The Product Presentation Pack and Eco Pack are delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you, no technician required. The Basic MICE Pack offers a technician as an add on, and the MICE Pack includes one. See No In-House AV Team? Here's What We Handle above.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: Is it cheaper to rent or buy a sound system for a small business?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: For a single event or occasional use, renting is generally more cost effective than buying, since it avoids the maintenance and storage costs of equipment you rarely use. Our Eco Pack covers sound, a microphone and lighting for a small event, delivered and collected for you.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: What AV equipment does a small business actually need for a product demo, workshop or client meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: It depends on the scenario: a product demo needs a sound system, a microphone and a projector for slides, which the Product Presentation Pack covers. An informal workshop mainly needs sound and a microphone, which the Eco Pack covers. A small client meeting benefits from a projector, which the Basic MICE Pack covers, with a technician available as an optional add on if you want one. See Match Your Scenario to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: How can I keep AV rental costs down for a small business event?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: Match the package to your actual guest count, skip optional add ons your event does not need such as the projector on the Eco Pack or the technician on the Basic MICE Pack, and book the package sized for your scenario rather than the next one up. See Keeping Costs Down above.

audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.question: How far in advance should a small business book AV rental equipment?
audio-visual-rental-for-small-businesses.answer: Book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed, to guarantee the package and date you want. Contact us with your event details and we will confirm availability.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: What is MEG's minimum notice policy for changes to an existing booking?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: The same 24 hour minimum that applies to every new booking applies to every change to one. All event gear rentals and technical services must be contracted, or reconfirmed, with at least 24 hours' advance notice to guarantee scheduling and logistical availability.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: What happens if my guest count crosses 50 or 80 guests after I've booked?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: Crossing from the Eco Pack's 50 guest capacity or the Wedding Pack's 80 guest capacity is a package change, not a quantity you add to. It is subject to whether the higher capacity system, and a technician if needed, are still available for your date, and it is still bound by the 24 hour minimum.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: Can I add a projector, smoke machine, or extra technician hours close to my wedding date?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: Yes. A projector and screen, a professional smoke machine, extra microphones, a premium acrylic lectern, modular stage platforms, and additional live technician hours can all be requested close to the date. Each is confirmed against real stock and technician availability at the time you ask, not guaranteed automatically.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: What happens if I need to change my wedding date after booking?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: Contact us as soon as the date changes and we confirm whether the new date is available for your package and technician. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack technicians are not interchangeable on request, and peak season Saturdays sell out first, so a postponement into that window can mean your new date is already booked.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: What if the weather forces a swap between an indoor and outdoor venue?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: A late indoor to outdoor swap is treated like any other change: subject to whether our AV setup can be reconfigured for the new setting on your date, and to the 24 hour minimum. See our indoor and outdoor wedding rental guides for what each setting actually needs.

managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.question: Do I get a discount if my guest count drops after booking?
managing-last-minute-wedding-rental-chan.answer: No. Package prices are fixed, and there is no documented option to remove an included item or downsize a guest count for a lower rate. Our tips for reducing wedding rental costs guide covers the real, honest cost levers, right sizing your package before you book is one of them.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: What do I need to rent for an outdoor wedding?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: A full outdoor wedding rental list usually spans tents, seating, catering equipment, decor and AV. Malaga Event Gear supplies only the last category, through the Wedding Pack: PA sound, ambient lighting, wireless microphones and a live technician. Tents, furniture, restrooms and decor need a separate vendor.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: Do I need a permit for outdoor wedding sound in Malaga?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: We do not handle permits or negotiate curfews with your venue. Confirm any noise curfew or amplified sound restriction with your venue before booking, common at fincas and villas around Malaga, and tell us the curfew so our live technician can size and time the sound system around it.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: How much sound power does an outdoor wedding need compared to indoors?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: Open air disperses sound further than an indoor room does, since there are no walls to reflect off, so an outdoor PA is set up to project across the space rather than fill a room. A wedding adds ceremony and reception zones on top of that, usually with different sound needs, which is why a live technician stays for both rather than leaving a single fixed setup.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: Do I need a generator for an outdoor wedding?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: We do not stock generators. Confirm your venue's power access with us when you book, especially for a remote finca or a beach location, and we will size the setup to what is actually available.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: How does wind affect outdoor wedding sound and lighting?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: Wind on a coastal terrace or an open lawn affects where a speaker stand or lighting rig can safely stand, and how far sound carries. Our technician reads wind exposure and ground surface on site and places equipment accordingly.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: What guest count fits an outdoor wedding AV setup?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: Guest count decides the package, not tent square footage. The Eco Pack suits up to 50 guests, self run after our crew delivers and tests it. The Wedding Pack suits up to 80 guests, with a live technician on site throughout, which matters more outdoors where wind, curfews and ceremony to reception transitions all need adjusting on the day.

outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.question: What's different about planning AV for an outdoor wedding versus an indoor one?
outdoor-wedding-rental-considerations.answer: Four things: sound projects across open space instead of filling a room with walls to reflect off, venue power needs confirming since we do not stock generators, many fincas and villas set a curfew on amplified sound that an indoor venue may not, and equipment placement has to account for wind and ground surface rather than a fixed indoor layout. See our indoor wedding rental essentials guide for the room acoustics and lighting side of that comparison.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: Is Malaga Event Gear's Wedding Pack eco friendly?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer: In the ways that apply to AV equipment: yes. It uses fairy light and warm LED ambient lighting rather than higher draw older fixtures, the equipment is reused across many events rather than bought once and discarded, and delivery stays local within Malaga and Granada.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: Does the Wedding Pack include eco friendly tents, furniture or decor?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer: No. The Wedding Pack is audio visual equipment only: sound, lighting, microphones and a technician. Tents, furniture, decor and catering are separate trades, not part of this package.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: Is LED lighting actually more energy efficient than other options?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer: Yes. Fairy lights and warm LED strings use meaningfully less power than incandescent or halogen fixtures for the same ambient effect, which is why the Wedding Pack uses them.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: What should I ask an AV rental company about their eco practices?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer:
Four questions cut through the marketing language and get you real answers.

Does it reuse equipment across events, or buy new gear per booking? We reuse every PA system, light and microphone across events.
What lighting technology does it use, LED or older incandescent or halogen fixtures? Our ambient lighting is fairy light and warm LED.
How local is its service area and delivery routes? We deliver within Malaga and extend to Granada.
Is delivery bundled into one trip or split across multiple vendors? The Wedding Pack is a single delivery covering sound, lighting and microphones together.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: How much does the Wedding Pack cost?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer: 650 euros, ex VAT, with Spain's 21 percent VAT added at checkout. The price includes delivery, setup and teardown. See exact pricing on our packages page.

eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.question: What if I want a fully sustainable wedding, not just eco friendly AV?
eco-friendly-wedding-rental-options.answer: Pair the Wedding Pack with vendors in the other trades, venue, catering, decor and favors, since AV rental alone cannot cover those. Our wedding rental essentials guide breaks down where AV fits among the rest.
